page.overview:
Who is Ailish?

Ailish was a Tarlafar and the mother of the Force-sensitive infant Bayrn, living with him in a mountain city on the world Caraad. After her son was witnessed using the Force to throw a pot while they were out shopping, Ailish rushed him home, but an Aqualish neighbor reported the child as the Galactic Empire had placed a bounty on Force-sensitive children. The bounty hunter Cad Bane then arrived at Ailish's home and stunned her before kidnapping Bayrn.

Ailish was a Tarlafar the pair lived in a mountain city but rumors began to spread about how Bayrn might be gifted or cursed. While out shopping on one of the city's market streets, Ailish carried her son to a flower stall and placed him on a nearby crate with his doll, stroking his head then leaving him to play while she spoke with the vendor. Bayrn began throwing his doll up in the air and catching it before accidentally throwing it into some pots.

With Ailish still distracted, Bayrn climbed down from the crate and crawled over to recover the doll, sending a pot flying through the air with the Force as he did so. This was witnessed by an Arcona and a human nearby, who pointed out Bayrn as the culprit when an angry Aqualish questioned who had thrown the pot. As the Aqualish dismissed the idea that an infant could have lifted the pot, Ailish became aware of the commotion and hurried over to collect a Bayrn, who had begun to wail. Apologizing to the trio discussing the incident, she then carried Bayrn away and returned to their home. Having listened to the Arcona speak more about Bayrn's apparent powers, the Aqualish watched the mother enter her home with interest and later reported the child from his neighboring apartment, as the Galactic Empire had placed a bounty on Force-sensitive children.

Based on the Aqualish's tip, the bounty hunter Cad Bane and his droid Todo 360 sought out Ailish's home one night. The mother was playing with Bayrn and his doll on the apartment's couch, feeding him a snack and then tickling him, when she heard Bane's footsteps outside. Seeing his silhouette passing by under the apartment's door, Ailish moved Bayrn from a table to the couch slightly further from the door and frowned as she moved over to the entryway. Worried, she glanced back at her child as Bane's silhouette returned beneath the door, prompting Ailish to pick up a shovel for defense.
